summary: R19 机构逻辑与局部范围；四列包装对接尚未通过。21,601 个产品位姿采样、264 次交接边界、2,161 次数量核对与 3,204 个喷头/停转退让状态采样通过。局部检查包含裸料落带、刀槽、抬框离带与出料脚标高。完整机械干涉、WebGL 浏览器及实料性能尚未验收。 23类局部接口、6,783个场景时刻、227,068对候选网格，采样中未检出相交。范围含新增紧固件与周边及分体管夹与加工头/转子/挡水板。指定配合按规则排除；孔和叠厚另查，宽相跳过小于0.2mm的AABB交叠。不证明完整CAD、连续扫掠、公差或叶片膜材无干涉。

rigid_interface_screen.scope: Selected rigid interfaces, sampled at the times listed in counts. Includes prior motion/support scenarios and new hardware versus surrounding parts and header clamps versus process heads, rotor and guards. New hardware scenarios use 0.05 s. Exact same-joint fastener meshes and designated plate/lug mates are excluded from collision screening; actual target bores and stack faces are checked separately in check-hardware19. Existing explicit bearing/nut/follower mates are excluded. Broad phase skips AABB overlap below 0.2 mm. Flexible leaves, film, hoses, continuous sweep, tolerances and remaining full-machine interfaces are not validated.
